commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== install packages =="
sudo -n yum install -y nfs-utils >/tmp/yum-nfs.log 2>&1 || (tail -50 /tmp/yum-nfs.log; exit 1)

echo "== create group/user dataops (gid/uid 4500) =="
if ! getent group dataops >/dev/null; then
  sudo -n groupadd -g 4500 dataops
fi
if ! getent passwd dataops >/dev/null; then
  sudo -n useradd -u 4500 -g 4500 -M -s /sbin/nologin dataops
fi
id dataops

echo "== create shared directory =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/nfs/shared
sudo -n chown dataops:dataops /srv/nfs/shared
sudo -n chmod 2770 /srv/nfs/shared
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /srv/nfs/shared

echo "== configure exports =="
NODE2_IP=$(echo "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node2"{print $1}')
echo "node2 ip: $NODE2_IP"
EXPORT_LINE="/srv/nfs/shared ${NODE2_IP}(rw,sync,no_subtree_check,root_squash)"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc
if ! grep -qF "/srv/nfs/shared" /etc/exports 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "$EXPORT_LINE" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/exports
else
  sudo -n sed -i "\|^/srv/nfs/shared|c\\${EXPORT_LINE}" /etc/exports
fi
cat /etc/exports

echo "== enable and start nfs services =="
sudo -n systemctl enable rpcbind nfs-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sudo -n systemctl restart rpcbind
sudo -n systemctl restart nfs-server
sudo -n exportfs -ra
sudo -n exportfs -v

echo "== firewall =="
if systemctl is-active --quiet firewalld; then
  sudo -n firewall-cmd --add-service=nfs --permanent || true
  sudo -n firewall-cmd --add-service=rpc-bind --permanent || true
  sudo -n firewall-cmd --add-service=mountd --permanent || true
  sudo -n firewall-cmd --reload || true
else
  echo "firewalld not active"
fi

echo "== verify service status =="
sudo -n systemctl is-active nfs-server
sudo -n showmount -e localhost
echo DONE
